summary: Audit fairness in hiring and performance AI, design human review controls, and document HR risk. Explore the practical course outline.
lede: AI fairness in HR examines how automated tools influence hiring, performance ratings and workforce planning. It is for HR directors, talent acquisition leaders and people analytics managers who need to review these systems and document decision controls. Participants map HR use cases, compare group outcomes, check screening criteria and vendor information, and draft human-review steps and audit records using NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 concepts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who select, govern, evaluate, or advise on AI-assisted hiring and workforce decisions. It suits experienced HR and adjacent specialists who need practical fairness review methods, not software engineering instruction.
modules: NIST AI RMF for HR Decisions
HR Fairness Reporting and Action Plans
prerequisites: Prior experience in HR, talent acquisition, people analytics, employment law, DEI, or AI governance is recommended. No coding or model-building experience is required; working knowledge of HR decision processes will help you apply the exercises.
